note: Taken from the owner's enterprise AI safety bow-tie conversation (documentation/1. requirements/sources.md). The consequences were only drawn in an image the page text does not carry, so this file ships none. A control is placed on a pathway in the order the conversation listed it, preventive barriers first and then detection and containment; the conversation had no rows for logging and observability or for cross-tenant and session leakage, so those two pathways have no controls. The sub-bow-tie for retrieval names threats and no controls, because the conversation named none.

risk.title: Loss of control over sensitive enterprise data through AI
risk.top_event: Sensitive information is disclosed, made accessible, or transmitted to an unauthorized party or system through an AI application, model, agent, or connected service.

pathways.title: Prompt input leakage
pathways.scenario: Employee pastes customer records, source code, or strategy documents into an unapproved AI service.

pathways.title: RAG / retrieval leakage
pathways.scenario: An AI assistant retrieves documents the requesting user should not be permitted to see.

pathways.title: Prompt injection
pathways.scenario: A malicious document or webpage instructs an AI agent to send confidential data to an external destination.

pathways.title: Agent/tool misuse
pathways.scenario: An AI agent with excessive permissions sends sensitive data via email, API, or external tools.

pathways.title: Model output leakage
pathways.scenario: An AI system reveals confidential information through its responses, including memorized training data.

pathways.title: Provider and integration leakage
pathways.scenario: Data is exposed through third-party processing, logging, retention, or an insecure connector.

pathways.title: Logging and observability leakage
pathways.scenario: Sensitive prompts, responses, or retrieved content are exposed in telemetry or debugging systems.

pathways.title: Cross-tenant / session leakage
pathways.scenario: A configuration or isolation failure makes one user's information accessible to another.

risk.title: An enterprise AI assistant discloses restricted information to an unauthorized user
risk.top_event: An enterprise AI assistant discloses restricted information to an unauthorized user.

pathways.title: Prompt injection through a retrieved page
